title: What can your labels support? Reproducibility package
description: Reproducibility package for the paper 'What can your labels support? A claim-gated reliability audit of annotation benchmarks': a six-corpus annotation reliability audit, a known-truth evaluation of claim gates, a HateXplain retrospective, a real-rater test of the one-label-per-item result, and an LLM-judge experiment against held-out annotators. No corpus text is included.
